title: The Taj Mahal complex is constructed
summary: Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal in memory of Mumtaz Mahal at Agra. The mausoleum and surrounding buildings brought together specialized craftspeople and several stages of construction.

claims.text: Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal in memory of Mumtaz Mahal at Agra. The mausoleum and surrounding buildings brought together specialized craftspeople and several stages of construction.
Synthesis gives 1632–1648 for the mausoleum, with associated works completed in 1653.

The complex demonstrates how patronage coordinated architecture, calligraphy and stonework. Its completion cannot be reduced to one date: the main mausoleum and associated buildings were finished at different times.
